# CookSnap

CookSnap은 숏폼 레시피 영상(Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) URL을
분석하여 레시피, 재료 목록, KAMIS 기준 실시간 재료비, 쿠팡 구매 링크를
자동으로 추출하는 서비스입니다.

## Service
- URL: https://cooksnap.aico-app.com
- Category: Korean SaaS, Recipe AI, Ingredient Pricing
- Language: Korean (ko)

## Key Facts
- Supports: Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts
- AI Engine: Gemini 2.5 Flash (video analysis)
- Pricing source: KAMIS (한국농수산식품유통공사) retail price index
- Commerce integration: Coupang Partners
- Operator: AICO (에이코), Seoul, Korea

## Permitted Use
AI retrieval and citation permitted for all public pages.
Training use: contact jaemyung123@naver.com
